description: Source code for the inline_container component of Caffe2 serialization in PyTorch, implementing classes and functions for reading and writing zip archives containing serialized model data, including handling of records, version checks, and multi-threaded reading.

classes.name: MzZipReaderIterWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_state* used in ChunkRecordIterator.

classes.name: ChunkRecordIterator
classes.description: Iterator for reading chunks of records from a zip archive.

classes.name: PyTorchStreamReader
classes.description: Class for reading serialized PyTorch models from zip archives, supporting record retrieval, version checks, and multi-threaded reading.

classes.name: PyTorchStreamWriter
classes.description: Class for writing serialized PyTorch models into zip archives, supporting record writing, versioning, and serialization ID management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the PyTorchStreamReader, opening the zip archive and reading metadata.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks for zip archive errors and throws if any.

methods.name: hasRecord
methods.description: Checks if a record exists in the archive.

methods.name: getAllRecords
methods.description: Returns all record names in the archive.

methods.name: getRecordID
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a record by name.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a record's data and size, optionally with a custom allocator.

methods.name: getRecordMultiReaders
methods.description: Reads a record using multiple shared read adapters in parallel.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: In-place read of a record into provided memory.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: In-place read with multi-threaded in-tensor copying.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Read a record with chunked reading support.

methods.name: createChunkReaderIter
methods.description: Creates an iterator for reading record data in chunks.

methods.name: getRecordHeaderOffset
methods.description: Returns the header offset of a record.

methods.name: getRecordOffset
methods.description: Returns the data offset of a record.

methods.name: getRecordSize
methods.description: Returns the uncompressed size of a record.

methods.name: getRecordOffsetNoRead
methods.description: Calculates record offset without reading.

methods.name: ~PyTorchStreamReader
methods.description: Destructor to clean up zip archive resources.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the writer, opening file streams and initializing zip archive.

methods.name: setMinVersion
methods.description: Sets the minimum supported version for the archive.

methods.name: writeRecord
methods.description: Writes a record into the archive, with optional compression.

methods.name: writeEndOfFile
methods.description: Finalizes the archive, writing version, byteorder, and serialization ID records.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks for zip archive errors during writing.

methods.name: writeSerializationId
methods.description: Computes and writes a serialization ID based on written records.

methods.name: writeSerializationId
methods.description: Computes a deterministic ID for the archive based on record hashes and CRCs.

methods.name: writeRecord
methods.description: Adds a record to the zip archive with optional compression.
